instruction: A candid documentary medium shot captures a ballet lesson inside a softly lit studio. On the left, the female ballet instructor in a black bodysuit (R1) stands in profile, guiding the young ballet student in a black tutu (R2) on the right. The instructor (R1) uses both hands to carefully adjust the student's (R2) raised right arm and extended left arm, correcting her form. The student (R2) faces forward, smiling directly at the camera. In the background, a grey wall, a wooden ballet barre, and warm overhead string lights create a soft, focused atmosphere with gentle shadows.
elements: R1 uses both hands to adjust R2's ballet arm positions
R1 is the instructor correcting R2's form rather than being corrected by R2
R2 receives guidance from R1 while holding a raised right arm and extended left arm
wooden ballet barre in the studio background
